column1: # DECLARED-DARK FDA SOURCES. A source in the extractor's DEFAULT_SOURCES that
# NO install preset requests. Being on this list means the omission is a
# DECISION with a reason, not an oversight.
# THE POINT OF THE FILE: without it, tests/test_every_default_source_is_requested.sh
# leaves only two moves when a source is deliberately withheld -- enable it
# (wrong, see below) or delete the test (worse). A third state lets the
# deferral be declared and dated so the next reader inherits the reason
# instead of re-deriving it, which is what cost a whole PR today.
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. Removing a row means the source is now requested
# by a preset. Adding one requires a reason and a condition to remove it.
